UKSSSC Group C Various Posts Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released the notification for the Group C Various Posts. This recruitment has been issued for 553 posts. The online application process for UKSSSC Group C Various Posts Recruitment 2026 has started from 08 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 07 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UKSSSC Group C Various Posts Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 September 2026
  • Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Online Correction Date : 12-14 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 150/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
